GREETINGS FROM THE OTHER SIDE

Hellooo

I’m Valeria, an aspiring Machine Learning and Robotics Engineer by day, and a lover of all craftsy things by night.

I started making these silly little tomato charms as a way to bring more whimsy to my every day life. There’s something so special about bringing your ideas to life and sharing it with the world. Each piece is handmade with care, precision, and its own personality.

Thank you for being here and supporting my tiny shop. I hope these little tomatoes bring you a bit of lightheartedness, wherever life takes you.

GOOD LITTLE QUESTIONS

Before you pick.

All the things you might be wondering.

How does the charm builder work?

Choose a keychain charm for your keys or bag, or a smaller phone charm. Keychains use a regular tomato; phone charms use a small tomato.

Both options include one strand with three beads and a little star bead on the side. Extra strands and beads add a charge. You can build up to 3 strands, with up to 5 beads per keychain strand or 3 per phone-charm strand.

Keychain clasps include a key ring, lobster clasp, or loop. Phone charms have USB-C and Lightning dust plug options. Check that a dust plug matches your phone’s port before ordering.

Click any bead position, choose a shape, then pick an individual bead. Enlarge a bead to see it closer; uploaded photos can show multiple sides. Your design and placeholder price update as you go.

What are the dimensions of the tomatoes?

There are two sizes at the moment: a small tomato for phone charms and a regular tomato for keychain charms. Measurements and weights are placeholders and will be confirmed.

The regular tomato dimensions are 2.6cm × 2.5cm × 2.2cm. Small tomato dimensions are [W] × [H] × [D] cm.

Can I order something from this preview?

You can build designs and try the bag. Payments are not open in this preview. Ordering becomes available after the artist connects the shop and finalizes products and policies.

Will a phone attachment fit my phone?

A phone loop needs a compatible case or attachment point, you can simply wrap the charm about that point.

A dust plug has to match your phone’s port: USB-C (most Android phones and iPhone 15 and newer) or lightning (older iPhones).

A plug made for a USB-C port will not fit a lightning port and vise versa.

How do I care for a polymer clay charm?

Handle gently, avoid pulling the strands or bending the clay, and wipe with a soft damp cloth. Keep away from prolonged heat and soaking. These small accessories are not toys.

What about shipping, returns and custom orders?

The artist is finalizing dispatch times, delivery regions, shipping charges, and return terms. Confirmed policies must be published before orders open.
